description: AI Decision Matrix — Weighted decision matrix for 2-8 options: AI scores every option against each criterion (1-10 with a one-line reason), then exact weighted totals, ranking, margin, a sensitivity check (does the winner change if any one criterion is dropped?), verdict CLEAR WINNER / CLOSE CALL / TIE, risks, unknowns that would change the answer and a Markdown table. options= separated by ; or |. Optional criteria= (e.g. cost:5;speed:3;risk:4 - weights optional; omitted criteria are proposed by the AI) and context= the situation. Price: $0.008 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: ai_decision_matrix
